major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown at two or fewer combo points and follow it straight into Killing Spree.

major_cooldowns.name: Roll the Bones
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Reroll it on cooldown while you are sitting at one buff or none, and keep any roll of two or more.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1214909 is the cast and aura id observed in all five sampled parses; the guide links the older 315508, which was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Between the Eyes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend it at six or more combo points to keep its damage buff rolling, and send it before Killing Spree when both come up together.

major_cooldowns.name: Killing Spree
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it right after Adrenaline Rush, and let Between the Eyes go first when both are ready so its damage buff carries into the spree.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 51690 is the cast id seen in all five parses; 57841, 57842, 474478, 474483 and 1235074 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown, and on a single target wait until your energy is off the cap so none of its energy is wasted.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 271877 is the cast id, cast in 3 of 5 parses; 271896 is its aura twin.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Flurry
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it up from two targets on, and recast it at four or fewer combo points once four or more enemies are in range.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 13877 is the cast and aura id observed in all five parses; 22482, 426586 and 429951 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cash it in as soon as Roll the Bones is showing three or more buffs, or two or more when you play Fatebound.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown is 360s; the guide states an effective in-combat cooldown of about 75s from Restless Blades, which matches the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Preparation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with Between the Eyes, Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree all on cooldown, aiming the reset at a burn or add phase without holding it long enough to lose a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Light's Potential
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it during Adrenaline Rush, on Bloodlust, or inside the last thirty seconds of the fight.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use potion cast in all five parses; the APL fills the spec's potion slot with it.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before a raid-wide hit to cut the area damage you take by 40%.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Sip it whenever you drop off full health to heal 20% of your maximum over four seconds.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it to shrug off a heavy magic hit or clear a harmful spell effect.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use it when melee or physical damage is aimed at you to dodge it outright.

rules.description: Open with Adrenaline Rush, Roll the Bones, Between the Eyes
rules.action: Pop Adrenaline Rush and Roll the Bones at the pull, then build up and spend on Between the Eyes.

rules.description: Adrenaline Rush at low combo points
rules.action: Finish first so the combo points it hands you are not wasted.

rules.description: Killing Spree straight after Adrenaline Rush
rules.action: Fire it in the window right after Adrenaline Rush instead of on its own.

rules.description: Between the Eyes at high combo points
rules.action: Build a near-full combo point bar before spending it.

rules.description: Sinister Strike without overcapping combo points
rules.action: Finish with Between the Eyes or Dispatch once your bar is nearly full instead of building again.

rules.description: Pistol Shot as your builder during Opportunity
rules.action: Fire Pistol Shot while Opportunity is up and keep Sinister Strike for when it is not.

rules.description: Blade Flurry only with extra targets in range
rules.action: Save it for packs and let it drop while you are on a lone target.
